directors.title: Directors and investment
directors.subtitle: Who runs each company, the money directors put in or took out, and loans given and taken · Admin and finance only
directors.noView: Directors and investment need the partners right. Ask Admin.
directors.noDirectors: No director recorded. Add them on Partners with Director ticked.

loan.title: Loans with directors and partners
loan.note: Each loan posts to the partner's loan account and the bank. Loans to directors (s.185) and other loans (s.186 limit) are checked by the server before anything posts.

loanDlg.title: Record money in or out
loanDlg.hint: Money lent to or by a director or partner. The server runs the Companies Act checks and refuses the entry until the CA's settings or the director's declaration are on file.

dec.title: Declarations on file
dec.hint: Type the date exactly as on the signed declaration.

remind.title: Reminders for directors
remind.one: Money a director lends a private company comes with the director's written note that it is not borrowed money.
remind.two: Each director's interest in other companies and trusts is noted every year and when it changes, so related-party deals show up.
remind.three: Loans to other companies, trusts or people are checked against the Companies Act limits before they are paid.
remind.ca: Confirm the details with your CA.
